title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person who violates this chapter shall be fined not more than $5,000 nor less than $1,000 or imprisoned not more than one year, or both.
bodyHtml: §516-5  Penalty.  Any person who violates this chapter shall be fined not more than $5,000 nor less than $1,000 or imprisoned not more than one year, or both. [L 1967, c 307, §6; HRS §516-5; am L 2015, c 237, §37]
